Recently, governments across the world are facing deep instability and questions of power. Trump lost the midterm elections as Democrats swept both the House and Senate in a historic blue wave. Israel has no political leader with a clear majority after the elections. Netanyahu’s bloc lost its majority and the country is stuck in a deadlock.In this episode of Aasaan Bhasha Mein, we ask the timeless question that these crises force upon us:
